prior_material_read: official EMS OWR 32/2010 PDF, printed pp.1911–1913 (question on 1912)

target.logical_form: There exists one finite connected complex X, with abelian fundamental group acting trivially on all higher homotopy groups and finite-dimensional total rational homotopy, such that for infinitely many primes p, rk_p(X)>rk_T(X).
target.ranks: rk_T=max rank of a torus acting freely on the actual X; rk_p=max rank of an elementary abelian p-group acting freely on the actual X. Actions are continuous unless the printed source or a theorem states otherwise.
target.fixed_space: X must be independent of p. The free actions may vary with p. Infinitely many primes is essential; prime-dependent X does not suffice.
target.homotopy_hypotheses: All higher homotopy groups, not merely rational action, must have trivial pi_1 action; total rational homotopy over degrees >=1 finite-dimensional.
target.source_bound: The printed asymptotic bound rk_p(X)<=-chi_pi(X) does not assert equality with rk_T.

falsification_plan: Verify one explicit X is a finite connected complex and check pi_1, its integral action on higher pi_n, and total rational homotopy directly.

Verify every asserted free finite group action for every stated prime and boundary prime; faithfulness alone is insufficient. Inspect possible isotropy and any hidden smooth/linear/equivariant restrictions.

Prove any upper bound for toral rank for arbitrary continuous actions on the actual X. Rule out unsupported reduction to a chosen fibration, smoothing/local linearity, manifold category, rational model or equivariance.

Audit obstruction/cohomology calculations: integral versus rational classes, torsion, multiplicativity, naturality, differentials, convergence, finite-dimensional quotients, dimension bounds and exceptional characteristic.
Compare actual ranks or sufficient strict inequalities; check quantifier order, fixed topology and whether action is on X or only its homotopy type.
Read exact primary theorem versions used, verify all hypotheses and distinguish pre-existing construction/theorem from new synthesis. Test attribution, priority and limits of literature coverage.

Audit all six release artifacts, metadata, supporting files, source manifest, original48 versus expanded192 custody, deterministic rebuild and portable checker, including meaningful negative controls.
Visually inspect all four frozen PDF pages; record actual access/read scope and failures; never substitute historical receipts for present external-body custody.
success_criteria: A completely supported deduction of the printed existential claim, with accurate novelty scope and a reproducible package. No claim of complete novelty merely from a bounded literature search.
